intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lakeland for 2026, and here is what he found: 19 family events, 9 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Holiday Craft Bazaar at Munn Park) through December 31 (Light Up BSP at Bonnet Springs Park), with the Lakeland Christmas Parade (December 3), the First Friday Holiday Spectacular at Munn Park (December 4) and the Lakeland Symphony Orchestra Christmas Carols (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Lakeland

  • 19 Christmas events for kids in Lakeland
  • 9 free events, including the Lakeland Christmas Parade, the First Friday Holiday Spectacular at Munn Park and the Holiday Craft Bazaar
  • Meet Santa: pictures with Santa at the Holiday Craft Bazaar (November 28) and Santa at Crews Bank during First Friday (December 4)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Lakeland Christmas Parade (December 3) and the new 40 foot Christmas tree at Munn Park (December 4)
  • Trains: none found; the North Pole Express Air Mail Edition is a live card on this page
  • Season: November 28 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Lakeland families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Christmas Town at Busch Gardens, Christmas in the Wild at ZooTampa and the Winter Village at Curtis Hixon.
